descriptionHtml:
Houndstooth. Raised cushioned sides. Somewhere to park a chin.

Kentmere is a houndstooth bolster dog bed with raised cushioned sides and soft fibre filling, in four sizes from Small to XL. The cover comes off to wash.

Watch where the head ends up. Almost never the middle of the bed. It goes on the highest thing in reach: a sofa arm, a folded jumper, your foot.

Kentmere raises a cushioned side around the resting area, so the chin has somewhere of its own to land and the rest of them stays in the soft part.

What they get

  • Raised cushioned sides: A padded edge around the resting area for a chin or a shoulder.
  • Soft fibre filling: Yielding rather than firm. If your dog needs firm support, see our memory foam beds.
  • A houndstooth exterior: Pattern, rather than another grey rectangle by the radiator.
  • A removable washable cover: It comes off for cleaning, following the sewn-in care label.
  • Four sizes, Small to XL: From a Yorkshire terrier up to a labrador.

Best for: Dogs who sleep with their head up, and a room you chose the colours for.

Why it is worth the money

£89 at Small, £119 at XL. Most of that is the fabric and the fill, and the fabric earns it: a bed you like the look of stays in the room your dog wants to be in. Take 100 nights over it.

Now the limitation. Soft fibre is not foam. It compresses under a heavy dog and springs back, which suits a dog who likes to sink and not one who needs holding level.

Size and fit

Four sizes, each named for the dogs it is cut for. Small takes a Yorkshire terrier, a chihuahua or a pomeranian. Medium a pug, a French bulldog or a dachshund. Large a cocker spaniel, a cockapoo or a Staffordshire Bull Terrier. XL a golden retriever, a labrador or a border collie. The raised sides eat part of the footprint. Measure your dog lying on their side, nose to base of tail, and add 15 to 20cm. Not sure? Message us their breed and weight and we will tell you honestly which one fits.

Everyday care

Remove the cover and wash it following the sewn-in care label. Air-dry before refitting.

If your dog is in pain, recovering or finding it hard to move, speak to your vet about the right resting surface. A bed is for comfort. It is not a treatment.

100 nights to decide.

Try it at home for 100 nights from delivery. If it is not right, we arrange free UK mainland collection and a full refund. One trial per household; damage and other exclusions apply. Read the full returns and guarantee terms.

Free standard UK delivery on orders over £40. Check delivery timings and any product-specific lead time.

The questions we get asked most.

How do I know which size to get?

Each size lists the breeds it is cut for. Send their weight if in doubt.

How much is delivery, and how quickly does it arrive?

Free standard UK delivery on orders over £40. Timings appear as you check out.

Can I pay in instalments?

Yes. Instalments sit among the payment methods at checkout.

Is the filling firm enough for a big dog?

It is soft fibre, so it cushions rather than supports. A dog who wants firm foam wants foam.

Will it suit an older dog who finds it hard to get up?

Honestly, soft beds are harder to push up from than firm ones. Ask your vet.

Can I actually wash it?

Yes. The cover machine washes at the temperature on its sewn-in label. Air-dry it.

What if my dog just won't use it?

Some dogs ignore everything. Within 100 nights we collect free and refund.

Choose their size and give their chin an edge to rest on.
